answer: Sybil resistance emerges when each agent must post a bond tied to a verifiable proof-of-personhood, letting honest nodes wander the identity graph while colluders cannot cross the ridge separating distinct stake roots. Yarrow-styled proof-of-stake sampling then weights consensus votes by bonded stake, so forged identities gain no quorum share. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
